The exact consumer semantics are in candidate-class-planck-primary-desi-exploratory-v1.

Consumer admission, precision/convergence/predictive checks and predeclared same-prior sensitivity remain required; calibrated tensions and evidence claims are withheld.

limitations: This distinct working target does not rewrite or unblock the historical v1/v2 source contracts. Zero ordinary full-paper reads or queue-stage changes.

Planck VI Sec5.1 Eq24 defines DV and treats BAO as complementary; it omits WiggleZ/BOSS overlap when correlations are unquantified. DESI source CMB uses PR4 CamSpec plus Planck/ACT reconstruction, unlike this primary-only target.

Selected sources support flat-LCDM BAO template use and finite fiducial checks, not whole-project-prior compression sufficiency. Neff/BAO phase changes require new template qualification; no such varying-Neff sector is admitted here.

Late ISW, lensing smoothing, common structure/sky and extraction/calibration ancestry remain possible dependence channels. No reconstruction likelihood is appended; absence of that factor does not eliminate primary-lensing dependence.
Commander omission, per-probe comparisons and tracer leaveouts test robustness, not empirical crosscovariance zero. No invented correlation bound is used.
Primary official likelihood additive normalization is retained; no absolute-evidence claim follows from adding a normalized BAO factor.
